shared_kernel.what: All three labs use one transaction kernel (core/livelab/kernel): locate, swap, journal, witness, findings, two-phase coordinator, session.

mechanisms.name: Live code swap (transaction kernel + vLLM adapter)
mechanisms.what: Replaces changed function bodies on every worker rank and in the engine core between the same two engine steps, with an undo journal and a witness that the new code ran.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: The whole restart (imports, weight load, profile run, JIT warm-up, CUDA graph capture).

measured_saving.setup: GB200, Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-FP8, TP1 and TP2, eager and CUDA graphs, 2026-11-06/07

mechanisms.note: PR #136 GPU receipt (B200, Qwen3-8B, TP=2): edit to committed 0.187 s, edit to first execution 0.190 s. Data parallel > 1 is refused (repos/vllm/livelab/adapter/README.md).

mechanisms.name: Constructor fresh-field re-initialization (kernel/reinit.py, PR #156)
mechanisms.what: Re-initializes pure fresh-field additions in `__init__` and `__post_init__` on existing heap instances at `live-T0` without restarting or forking the engine.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Forked or warm engine restart for pure-field constructor additions (`#62872`).

measured_saving.setup: 1x B200, Qwen3-8B TP1, N=3

mechanisms.note: Verified on upstream vLLM PR #62872 (`Scheduler.__init__` pure-field addition `set() -> {}`): 1.410 s with CUDA graphs (30.4x vs 42.93 s forked restart) and 1.806 s eager (9.5x vs 17.17 s forked restart), undo 1.58 ms (23,440x).

mechanisms.name: Triton kernel rebuild in place
mechanisms.what: Rebuilds an edited @triton.jit kernel inside the running process and counts its launches as the witness, instead of restarting to recompile it.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Process restart for a GPU-kernel edit.

measured_saving.setup: 1x B200, vLLM 0.33.0, Qwen3-8B, eager; baseline is a warm model load

mechanisms.note: Install 78-80 ms. repos/vllm/docs/architecture.md:99-100 also records 0.07 s vs a 61.5 s restart. PR #136 re-verified the launch witness at TP=2 (1692/1692).

mechanisms.name: Selective CUDA graph recapture
mechanisms.what: After a commit, recaptures only the CUDA graphs the edit touches, in the same step gap, and keeps the old graphs for an instant undo.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Full CUDA graph capture at start-up (and the restart around it).

measured_saving.setup: 1x B200, Qwen3-8B TP1, 166 graphs; 1-bucket recapture 0.369 s; full 166-graph recapture 5.48-6.09 s; undo 1.2-2 ms

mechanisms.note: Verified at TP1 only. TP>1, GB200 and the V2 model runner are listed as not verified. PR #144 (open) fixes recapture_extend keeping TP ranks in step.

mechanisms.name: Zygote (fork server) with module refresh
mechanisms.what: Imports vLLM and its libraries once, then forks each `vllm serve` from that state; modules edited since are re-imported in the fork.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Python and library imports (8,631 modules, 12.7 s).

measured_saving.setup: 1x B200, Qwen3-8B TP1 eager, launch to /health, 2026-11-06; leaf edit 10.2 s, core edit 12.4-13.7 s

mechanisms.name: Weight holder over CUDA IPC (`weights.py`, `vllm preload` daemon)
mechanisms.what: A daemon keeps the processed weights on the GPU; a restarted engine maps them instead of reading the checkpoint.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Weight load from disk.

measured_saving.setup: load_model step, 1x GB200, Qwen3-8B TP1 eager, 2026-11-07; time to healthy 51.85 -> 46.80 s

mechanisms.note: Not verified at TP>1 or in graph mode.

mechanisms.name: KV-cache plan reuse (`kvplan.py`)
mechanisms.what: Saves the measured KV-cache memory plan and restores it on the next start, skipping the profiling forward pass.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: The memory-profile run that sizes the KV cache.

measured_saving.setup: 1x GB200, Qwen3-8B TP1 eager; time to healthy 51.85 -> 43.97 s; cold cache root profile run 62.27 s (PR #30)

mechanisms.name: Launcher with all three holders (zygote + IPC weights + KV plan)
mechanisms.what: One CLI (`engine.py start`) that starts a server from the zygote with resident weights and a reused KV plan.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Imports, weight read and profile run together.

measured_saving.setup: 1x GB200, Qwen3-8B TP1 eager, 2026-11-07; 7.0x; greedy output bit-identical

mechanisms.name: Weight lease, NCCL seeder and standby pool
mechanisms.what: K engines on a GPU share one weight copy; a holder on another GPU is filled by an NCCL copy instead of a checkpoint read; a router fails over to a standby engine.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Weight read and per-engine weight memory; recovery time after a crash or a bad patch.

measured_saving.setup: weight attach, 1 node of B200 GPUs, Qwen3-8B TP1, vLLM 0.33.0 fork; MoE model 12.87 -> 2.10 s; engine weight memory 15.27 GiB -> 0.0 GiB

mechanisms.note: The PR says plainly that start-up savings are small: time to healthy 32.31 -> 29.80 s. Other numbers: NCCL seed 31.5 ms for 16.4 GB; failover 29.8-66.1 ms from fault to first token (Qwen3-8B). Weight patches only; TP>1, EP and cross-node not run. Replaces the PR #125 version, which was a simulation.

mechanisms.name: Live reconfigure of scheduler limits
mechanisms.what: Changes `max_num_seqs` (and `max_num_batched_tokens`) in the running engine between two steps and reads the value back before recording it.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: A restart to change a launch flag.

measured_saving.after: 0.0022 (round trip; 0.027 ms in the engine loop)
measured_saving.setup: B200, vLLM 0.15.1, Qwen3-8B, `--max-num-seqs 4`

mechanisms.note: Only `max_num_seqs` was changed live on GPU. `max_num_batched_tokens` is implemented but not run on GPU. Every other flag restarts the engine. The tier latencies in repos/vllm/kb/reconfiguration_matrix.md are targets, not measurements.

mechanisms.name: KV-cache snapshot and replay
mechanisms.what: Saves the KV blocks and RNG state of a running batch per KV-cache group and restores them, so the same steps can be replayed.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Re-prefilling a long context before each candidate step.

measured_saving.setup: B200, gemma-3-1b-it (7 KV groups), 3.41 MB snapshot; 16/16 replayed steps token-identical

mechanisms.note: No before/after start-up saving is recorded. The module is quarantined: it covers the model runner only and nothing in the measured path uses it. PR #129 (the original) was CPU-only.

mechanisms.name: Parallelism resharder (TP/DP/EP)
mechanisms.what: Re-slices resident weights for a new tensor-, data- or expert-parallel layout without reading the checkpoint.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Weight reload when the parallel layout changes.
mechanisms.note: CPU tensor tests only; no GPU collective was run. PR #148 (open) adds a MoE reshard refusal.

mechanisms.name: Fork-safety guards, NUMA affinity and thread clamping (`core/livelab/forksafe.py`)
mechanisms.what: Answers import-time GPU queries from NVML so the zygote never initializes CUDA, binds forked workers to their GPU's CPU socket and clamps thread pools.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Lets a fork server exist at all; no direct start-up saving recorded.
mechanisms.note: PR #128 records no GPU overhead numbers. The no-CUDA-in-zygote guard itself is exercised by every GPU zygote run above.

mechanisms.name: Autotune config reuse
mechanisms.what: Reuse the kernel autotuner's saved configuration instead of re-tuning at start.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Kernel autotune at start-up.

mechanisms.name: Zygote supervision and fail-closed reset
mechanisms.what: The zygote reaps its ranks, ranks die with the zygote, a gone client cannot kill the lab, and `reset` refuses when the state keys do not match.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Stuck GPUs and manual clean-up after a fault; no start-up saving.
mechanisms.note: 30-check GPU driver on 2x B200, all pass: reset 1.9 s, install about 0.05 s, loss bit-identical after faults.

mechanisms.name: Thread clamping and GC freeze in the zygote
mechanisms.what: Clamps OMP and compile threads to 1 and freezes the garbage-collector heap before forking.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Extra threads per forked rank (31 fewer).
mechanisms.note: The steady-state step-time confirmation on GPU is listed as not verified.

caveats: GPU receipts are summaries inside PR descriptions and kb files; the raw run logs are not in the repo (PR #141).
Most vLLM GPU runs are TP1 on one GPU; TP>1 is verified only for the kernel fix (PR #136) and the 19-PR replay.
PR #123 (reconfigure) and #125 (weight pool) were merged CPU-only and partly simulated; PRs #137 and #135 replaced them with GPU-verified versions.
